items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: I know Larry Bornstein got the name over the door.

ctx.x: You think the destruction people just came in and smashed everything? Yeah. That's an awful shame. Wish I would have thought about something like that. I don't know. Yeah, you should have been hanging around.
I know Larry Bornstein got the name over the door.
You know, the big wooden name over the door to San Jacinto over the front of it. Larry got that. He was hanging up in his restaurant. Yeah, we had the Cal Don there too.
